selectionRule: Before fetching, select all four returned records from each stratum in response order. Do not substitute records because media fail. Record empty strata, duplicates, failed responses and unsupported types honestly.
supplementaryReads: Same recent-raster filter at page=2 for adjacent-page comparison
Detail for first recent-raster and first older-raster identifiers
mediaRule: Request only existing HTTPS stampchain.io /stamps/<64-hex>.<png|jpg|jpeg|gif|webp> originals whose advertised MIME is the corresponding raster type. Do not request HTML, SVG, /content/, generation or refresh endpoints. Verify content type, magic bytes and local decoding; record other formats as intentionally unsupported. No retries or load test.
